en.title:
Switch providers.
Keep your setup.
en.description: Switch OpenAI and DeepSeek in VS Code Codex with separate provider profiles. Windows local and Linux Remote SSH accounts are managed separately when their home directories are separate.
en.guidesTitle: Three things you came here to do
en.scopeNote: Configuration illustration — not a live API screenshot. Windows using the same OS account/home share selection. SSH aliases and shared NFS homes can share state too. Reload applies changes to new processes; running tasks are not hot-swapped.
en.choice: One saved provider choice per account/home
en.label: VS CODE EXTENSION · MIT · NO LOCAL RELAY
limits: Implemented targets: Windows x64 local VS Code and Linux Remote SSH. Local macOS/Linux, WSL, containers, Codespaces and browser VS Code are not supported.
Install openai.chatgpt on the same extension host and initialize the normal Codex config first. The launcher expects its bundled binary.
The key is plaintext in an isolated config file; masked input is not encryption. Returning to OpenAI does not erase keys or backups.
Configuration status is not an API health check. Actual model calls need your own credentials and may incur charges.
en.footer: Independent community project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI, DeepSeek or Microsoft. No analytics or third-party scripts on this page.
en.star: Useful in your workflow? A GitHub star is welcome — never required.

guides.title: Use DeepSeek in Codex
guides.summary: Install in the right place, select the provider and reload when ready.
steps: Install dzr.codex-local-model-switcher alongside openai.chatgpt in the local or remote extension host. Initialize your existing Codex setup and privately back up its configuration.
Save your work. Run Codex Source: Use DeepSeek Direct and enter your key in the masked input if requested. A stored key can be reused.
Choose Reload current window when ready. Check Show Current Codex Source Status, then separately send a minimal request in a disposable folder. This may incur service charges.
guides.note: direct: true means the configured endpoint and wire API match direct mode. It does not establish working network access, model entitlement, balance or answer quality.

guides.title: Switch back to OpenAI
guides.summary: Select the normal profile without deleting either provider configuration.
steps: Run Codex Source: Use GPT (OpenAI). This selects the normal .codex directory; its existing contents still determine which provider actually runs.
Save work and reload. Existing processes keep their original environment until restarted. Same-home windows share the saved choice.
Check your original Codex setup. Switching back does not repair an already broken normal profile, erase the DeepSeek key or restore the pre-extension executable setting.
guides.note: To stop using the switcher, select the normal profile, disable the extension, restore the previous chatgpt.cliExecutable override (or remove it if none existed), and reload. Do not delete .codex. Check the repository guide before restoring remote compatibility settings.

guides.title: Set up Remote SSH
guides.summary: Install on the remote extension host, not just on your computer.
steps: Connect to the Linux SSH host. In Extensions, find the SSH: your-host group rather than Local.
Install both openai.chatgpt and dzr.codex-local-model-switcher there. Check Bash, Python 3, GNU utilities, VS Code Server and the remote Codex config.
Use Show Current Codex Source Status in that remote window. A remote account with a separate home has a separate choice; another SSH alias to the same home does not.
guides.command: Codex Source: Show Current Codex Source Status
guides.note: Do not publish SSH addresses, authentication files or raw logs. The helper's missing-dependency message should be resolved on the remote host, not by replacing API keys.

zh.title:
切换模型来源。
保留原有配置。
zh.description: 在 VS Code Codex 中切换 OpenAI 与 DeepSeek，不必反复手改配置。Windows 本地与主目录独立的 Linux Remote SSH 账户，分别保存模型来源选择。
zh.scopeTitle: 主目录独立，选择才独立。
zh.scopeNote: 配置关系示意，不是真实 API 调用截图。同一账户、同一主目录下的窗口共享选择；SSH 别名和 NFS 主目录也可能共用状态。重载只影响新进程，不会热切换运行中的任务。
zh.choice: 每个账户主目录保存一份选择
zh.label: VS CODE 扩展 · MIT 开源 · 无需本地中继
zh.limitsTitle: 安装前需要知道的边界
limits: 当前实现面向 Windows x64 本地与 Linux Remote SSH；不支持本地 macOS/Linux、WSL、容器、Codespaces 或网页 VS Code。
先在同一扩展宿主安装 openai.chatgpt，并初始化原有 Codex 配置。启动器定位扩展自带的二进制文件。
密钥以明文保存在隔离配置文件中，输入遮罩不是加密；切回 OpenAI 不会删除密钥或备份。
配置状态不等于调用成功。实际模型调用需要自己的凭据，也可能产生服务费用。
zh.footer: 独立社区项目，与 OpenAI、DeepSeek、Microsoft 无官方隶属或背书关系。此页面不使用统计追踪或第三方脚本。
zh.star: 项目对你有帮助时，可以在 GitHub 点 Star；这不是使用条件。

guides.title: 在 Codex 中使用 DeepSeek
guides.summary: 装在正确的环境，选择模型来源，准备好后重载。
steps: 在同一扩展宿主安装 dzr.codex-local-model-switcher 和 openai.chatgpt。先初始化原有 Codex，并私下备份配置。
保存当前工作，运行 Codex Source: Use DeepSeek Direct。需要时通过遮罩输入框填写密钥；已有密钥时会复用。
准备好后选择 Reload current window。先检查状态，再在可丢弃目录发出一个最小请求。请求仍可能产生服务费用。
guides.note: direct: true 只说明配置中的端点和协议符合直连条件，不代表网络正常、模型有权限、账户有余额或回答质量已通过验证。

guides.title: 切回原有 OpenAI 配置
guides.summary: 选择原有配置目录，不删除任何一套凭据。
steps: 运行 Codex Source: Use GPT (OpenAI)，启动器改用原有 .codex。目录里实际配置了什么，仍由原有内容决定。
保存工作后重载。已运行的进程保留原来的环境；同一主目录下的其他窗口共享选择。
检查原有 Codex 是否正常。切回不会修复原本已经损坏的配置，也不会清除 DeepSeek key 或恢复扩展安装前的可执行文件设置。
guides.note: 停止使用切换器时，先选原配置、禁用扩展，再恢复原来的 chatgpt.cliExecutable（原本没有覆盖则移除覆盖），然后重载。不要删除 .codex；远程兼容设置的恢复步骤见仓库指南。

guides.title: Remote SSH 应该装在哪里
guides.summary: 安装到 SSH 扩展宿主，不是只安装在本机。
steps: 先连接 Linux SSH 主机，在扩展面板找到 SSH: 主机名 分组，而不只是 Local。
在该分组安装 openai.chatgpt 与 dzr.codex-local-model-switcher，并检查 Bash、Python 3、GNU 工具、VS Code Server 和 Codex 配置。
在 SSH 窗口运行状态命令。远程账户拥有独立主目录时才保存独立选择；给同一主目录增加 SSH 别名不会产生隔离。
guides.command: Codex Source: Show Current Codex Source Status
guides.note: 不要公开 SSH 地址、认证文件或原始日志。缺少远程依赖时，应修复对应依赖，而不是反复更换 API key。
